chapter.verse: Judah gam sungah Pasian kithei a, Israel gam sungah ama min lian hi.
Salem khua sungah ama omna kibawlin, Zion khua sungah ama teen’na mun kibawl hi.
Amah in tua lai-ah thaltangte, lum, namsau leh galhiamte kuaitan hi.
A om ngitnget mualliante sangin nang na min thangzaw-in na lianzaw hi.
Lungsim khauhte’ neihsa nate kisutkhia a, amaute ihmucip suak uh hi; gal hat mi khempeuhte in amau khut uh zang thei nawn lo uh hi.
Jakob’ Pasian aw, nangma thuhilhna hangin sakol leh a tung tuangpa khawlcip uh hi.
Ahih hangin nang zahtak-huai mahmah teh! Na heh khit phot ciangin nangma mai-ah kua ding zo ding ahi hiam?
Vantung panin nangmah in thukhenna na genkhia hi; gimna a thuak leitung mi khempeuh hon dingin Pasian in thu khen ding hong kipat ciangin leitung lau-in taang loin om hi.
Mite’ hehna in nangmah hong kiphatna piangsak ding a, na hehna pan a suakta sun mite in nangmah pahtawina pawi bawl ding uh hi.

Topa na Pasian’ tungah na thuciamnate uh bawl un la, tuate zui un; leitung kumpite tungah a zahtak-huai, uliante’ lungsim a niamkhiat, zahtak ding a hipa’ tungah, ama kim-a om mi khempeuhte in letsong puak ta uh hen!
